chunks: From him, from Ali, from his father, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: "Please treat your families with delight every Friday by providing something of fruit or meat, so that they may rejoice because of Friday."

key_terms.أَطْرِفُوا: Please treat with delight or kindness

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended way to treat one's family on Fridays according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights the Shia emphasis on *tariff* (treating with kindness) within the domestic sphere, linking material generosity to spiritual joy. By encouraging the provision of fruit or meat every Friday, the Prophet (peace be upon him) ensures that the day of congregational prayer is marked by familial warmth and anticipation, reinforcing the social dimension of worship. This practice reflects the broader Shia tradition of balancing ritual piety with emotional well-being in the home.
